nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) _balances holding token balances of every holder.
Private nested mapping _allowances[owner][spender] storing approvals; written by _approve.
Private _tTotal total supply, 88888888888 * 10**18, minted to deployer in constructor.
Private string _name = '888 INU  '.
Private string _symbol = '888  '.
Private uint8 _decimals = 18.
Ownable._owner, the nominal contract owner stored privately; used by owner() and by _approve's owner bypass check.
Ownable.newComer initialized to _msgSender() at declaration; it is the value actually checked by the onlyOwner modifier instead of _owner.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller returned by _msgSender() and used for ownership, transfers and approvals.
jackpot constructor: sets _balances[_msgSender()] = _tTotal and emits Transfer from address(0).
name() public view returning _name.
symbol() public view returning _symbol.
decimals() public view returning _decimals.

_approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount) private: if ol != owner() it forces _allowances[ol][tt] = 0 and emits Approval with value 4, otherwise stores amount; anomalous owner-only approval path.
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public calling _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount).
transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) public: calls _transfer then _approve(sender, _msgSender(), allowance.sub(amount)).
totalSupply() public view returning _tTotal.
balanceOf(address account) public view returning _balances[account].
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public calling _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount).
_transfer(sender, recipient, amount) internal: zero-address checks, SafeMath sub/add on _balances and Transfer event.
owner() public view returning _owner.
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner: sets _owner = address(0) and emits OwnershipTransferred.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) private onlyOwner: zero-address require and _owner = newOwner; not externally callable.
Context._msgSender() internal view virtual returning msg.sender.
Context._msgData() internal view virtual returning msg.data.
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) internal: performs a low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") after a balance require.
Address._functionCallWithValue(target, data, weiValue, errorMessage) private: forwards a low-level target.call{value: weiValue}(data) and bubbles revert data via assembly.
Low-level value transfer recipient.call{value: amount}("") with no state update ordering guarantee, enabling reentrant callbacks to the recipient.
Low-level arbitrary call target.call{value: weiValue}(data) with uncontrolled target and calldata, enabling reentrancy and arbitrary external execution.
Silent allowance reset/forced Approval(ol, tt, 4) branch inside _approve for any caller that is not owner(), a privilege/accounting anomaly.
onlyOwner modifier validates newComer (captured msg.sender at deployment) instead of _owner, breaking the real ownership access-control model.
Parameter ol (approval owner) of _approve.
Parameter tt (approval spender) of _approve.
Parameter amount of _approve.
Parameter spender of approve.
Parameter amount of approve.
Parameter sender of transferFrom.
Parameter recipient of transferFrom.
Parameter amount of transferFrom.
Parameter account of balanceOf.
Parameter recipient of transfer.
Parameter amount of transfer.
Parameter sender of _transfer.
Parameter recipient of _transfer.
Parameter amount of _transfer.
Parameter owner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter recipient (payable) of Address.sendValue, target of the value call.
Parameter target of Address._functionCallWithValue, the arbitrary contract invoked.
Local address msgSender in Ownable constructor assigned from _msgSender() before writing _owner.
Local bool success captured from the low-level call in Address.sendValue.
Local bytes returndata captured from the low-level call in Address._functionCallWithValue.

edges.reason: _msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender.
approve passes the untrusted msg.sender as the approval owner.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender when decrementing the allowance.
transfer sends from the untrusted msg.sender.
Constructor mints the whole supply to the untrusted msg.sender.
newComer is initialized with _msgSender(), fixing the deployer as the only account passing onlyOwner.
onlyOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against newComer, not against _owner.
Constructor writes _balances[_msgSender()].
Constructor mints _tTotal supply.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
approve delegates to _approve.
transferFrom re-approves via _approve after transferring.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
_approve calls owner() and compares ol != owner() to choose the privileged branch.
_approve reaches the silent allowance-reset / Approval(ol, tt, 4) branch for non-owner callers.
_transfer performs SafeMath sub/add mutations on _balances.
balanceOf reads _balances.
name() returns _name.
symbol() returns _symbol.
decimals() returns _decimals.
owner() returns _owner.
renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the flawed onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is guarded by the flawed onlyOwner modifier.
Address.sendValue executes the low-level value call.
Address._functionCallWithValue executes the low-level arbitrary call.
The value call transfers control to the untrusted recipient, which can re-enter the caller.
The arbitrary call invokes the untrusted target, which can re-enter before state is settled.
amount parameter flows into _approve's allowance write.
ol parameter selects the approval branch and index in _approve.
tt parameter indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.
spender parameter flows from approve into _approve.
amount parameter flows from approve into _approve.
sender parameter of transferFrom drives balance and allowance accounting.
recipient parameter of transferFrom receives the tokens.
amount parameter of transferFrom is subtracted from the allowance.
account parameter indexes _balances in balanceOf.
recipient parameter of transfer flows into _transfer.
amount parameter of transfer flows into _transfer.
sender parameter is debited in _transfer.
recipient parameter is credited in _transfer.
amount parameter is added/subtracted in _transfer's SafeMath operations.
owner parameter indexes _allowances in allowance.
spender parameter indexes _allowances in allowance.
newOwner parameter is written into the _owner state variable.
recipient parameter is the target of the low-level value call.
target parameter is the address invoked by the arbitrary low-level call.
Local msgSender captured in the constructor is written to _owner, while newComer is used for auth.
success local receives the low-level call result in sendValue.
returndata local receives the low-level call result in _functionCallWithValue.

The tt parameter only exists as an argument of _approve and has no independent semantic identity.
The amount parameter only exists as an argument of _approve and has no independent semantic identity.
The spender parameter is only meaningful inside approve.
The amount parameter is only meaningful inside approve.
The sender parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom.
The amount parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom.
The account parameter is only meaningful inside balanceOf.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful inside transfer.
The amount parameter is only meaningful inside transfer.
The sender parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer.
The owner parameter is only meaningful inside allowance.
The spender parameter is only meaningful inside allowance.
The newOwner parameter is only meaningful inside transferOwnership.
The recipient parameter is the direct target of the low-level value call and carries its reentrancy risk.
The target parameter is the direct callee of the arbitrary low-level call and carries its reentrancy risk.
The msgSender local is a constructor-scoped temporary used to seed _owner.
The success local merely stores the outcome of the low-level value call.
The returndata local merely stores the result of the arbitrary low-level call.
